prompt: Parsing a 50 MB CSV in the browser freezes the UI for 8 seconds.
why: Parse in a web worker so the main thread stays free.
trap: Showing the rows is a separate problem; parsing freezes it.

prompt: Applying a filter to a photo in a web editor makes buttons unresponsive until it finishes.
why: Run the pixel work in a worker (or OffscreenCanvas).
trap: Image optimization is about delivery, not processing.

prompt: Building a client-side search index over 20,000 docs blocks typing for several seconds on load.
why: Build the index in a worker and query it there.
trap: Debouncing typing won't help if the thread is busy.

prompt: Hashing a large file before upload makes the progress bar stop moving.
why: Hash in a worker; the main thread keeps painting.
trap: The upload isn't slow; the main thread is blocked.

prompt: A live Markdown preview of a 200-page document makes typing lag.
why: Render the preview in a worker (and debounce it).
trap: Debounce helps, but the render still blocks when it runs.

prompt: A browser game freezes for a moment whenever enemies compute paths across a large map.
tells: compute paths across a large map
trap: Heavy computation belongs off the main thread.

prompt: Decoding video frames with WebAssembly makes the page's buttons stop responding.
why: Run the WASM module in a worker.
trap: WASM is fast but still blocks if on the main thread.

prompt: Sorting 2 million rows client-side freezes the page for 3 seconds.
why: Sort in a worker; post results back.
